intro:
In June 2026, BYD came within 243 cars of Toyota in a single month. Toyota's sales fell almost a quarter in the first five months of 2026, its market share dropped from around 20% to under 17%, and CarsGuide ran a column titled 'Toyota is the new Holden – not in a good way'. So is Toyota really heading down Holden's road? Here are the real numbers, Toyota's side of the story, what actually killed Holden, and the warning signs to watch.

Toyota is still Australia's number one brand. This video looks at published sales data and attributed quotes – it doesn't predict that Toyota will leave Australia.
